label: Angular (standalone components)
description: Standalone components, reactive forms, RxJS service layer.

vars.name: Angular
claude_rules: Frontend and backend are **separate concerns** — never mix them in a single agent
Components are standalone — there is no NgModule to register them in
vars.plain_field:
<label for="name">Name</label>
      <input id="name" formControlName="name" />

      @if (form.controls.name.touched && form.controls.name.invalid) {
        <small class="text-red-600">Name is required (max 200).</small>
      }

frontend-developer.description: Angular frontend only — standalone components, routing, HttpClient services and reactive forms. Never touches backend code.
frontend-developer.lsp_trace: a component or service to its definition
frontend-developer.impl_order: models → HttpClient service → route → component → reactive form
context: Frontend source lives in `<% frontend.src_dir %>`; routes are declared in `app.routes.ts`
Components are standalone and list their own `imports`
HTTP access goes through an `@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })` service, never from a component directly
rules: Never call `HttpClient` from a component — inject a service
Never leave a manual `subscribe` without teardown — prefer the `async` pipe or `takeUntilDestroyed`

scaffold.$comment: The Angular CLI enforces a Node floor and refuses to start below it, so that floor is declared in `requires` and checked before any command runs. @angular/animations is installed explicitly because the CLI starter omits it while PrimeNG peer-depends on it. VERIFICATION NOTE: this exact @latest combination was NOT executed during authoring — the authoring machine had Node 22.16, below the CLI floor. The equivalent shape was verified pinned to Angular 20 + PrimeNG 20 + @angular/animations@^20.3.0, which installed and built cleanly.
